name: Noobs Vs Zombies: Legions (Beta)
desc:
Welcome to Noobs Vs Zombies: Legions! A fan made game which combines elements from your favorite games: NVZ Realish and NVZ Tycoon 2!

NVZ Realish: https://www.roblox.com/games/527271999/Noobs-vs-Zombies-Realish
Tycoon 2: https://www.roblox.com/games/2639055821/Noobs-vs-Zombies-Tycoon-2

Game is in partial development. Though not complete, it may not always be worked on.

Type /votekick in the chat to vote-kick exploiters or rule-breakers!

Credit to HeadKing for Heavy Light Armor, ManLostInDarkness for Mutant Knight Model
Thumbnails made by KingAtlec, GIBUSHAT4, WaffleTUBE10

If you need to purchase a Twinedhealer89 gamepass, here is his place: https://www.roblox.com/games/12911064470/Storage-Place
